propositions: REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY inline-PEM value is read into config but never removed from os.environ, leaving the raw secret visible in process environment dumps and inherited by child processes like ssh-keygen and git
_private_key_env() at config.py:79 calls os.environ.get() to capture the inline PEM but does not pop it, causing the variable to persist for the process lifetime after config load

Child processes spawned after config load (ssh-keygen via keyprov._validate_key_file and git via workspace._git) inherit the unset REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY from os.environ since they do not pass explicit env parameter
Consuming the environment variable at the single read boundary in _private_key_env() via os.environ.pop() will transfer the secret into the config object and remove it from the process environment
